diagrams.source:
---
title: EcoTrack ERD - Desktop and Mobile
config:
  theme: base
  look: classic
  layout: dagre
  er:
    diagramPadding: 6
    titleTopMargin: 4
    entityPadding: 4
    minEntityWidth: 90
    minEntityHeight: 30
    nodeSpacing: 22
    rankSpacing: 28
    fontSize: 12
  themeVariables:
    fontFamily: Arial
    fontSize: 12px
    lineColor: "#64748b"
---
erDiagram
    direction TB

    AUTH_USERS["AUTH.USERS"] {
        uuid id PK
        varchar email
    }
    ADMINISTRATORS {
        text id PK
        uuid auth_user_id FK, UK
        text username UK
        text email UK
        text role
        boolean is_active
    }
    STAFF["STAFF - MOBILE"] {
        text id PK
        uuid auth_user_id FK, UK
        text room_id
        text name
        text role
        text assignment_scope
        text status
    }
    BUILDINGS {
        text id PK
        text admin_id FK
        text name
    }
    FLOORS {
        text id PK
        text building_id FK
        text name
    }
    ROOMS {
        text id PK
        text floor_id FK
        text admin_id FK
        text name
        integer node_limit
    }
    NODES {
        text id PK
        text room_id FK
        text maintainer_id FK
        text monitor_aircon_id FK
        text name UK
        text device_mode
        text wake_time
        text sleep_time
        integer interval_val
        text interval_unit
        double rotation_rpm
    }
    AIRCONS {
        text id PK
        text room_id FK
        text controller_node_id FK
        text asset_tag UK
        text name
        text brand
        text model
        text protocol
        jsonb desired_state
        jsonb reported_state
    }
    RULES {
        text id PK
        text admin_id FK
        text room_id FK
        text type
        text condition
        numeric value
        boolean enabled
    }
    RULE_NODES {
        text id PK
        text rule_id FK
        text node_id FK
    }
    NOTIFICATIONS["NOTIFICATIONS - DESKTOP"] {
        text id PK
        text admin_id FK
        text room_id FK
        text rule_id FK
        text type
        text content
        timestamptz created
    }
    MAINTENANCE_REPORTS {
        text id PK
        text aircon_id FK
        text staff_id FK
        text admin_id FK
        text room_id FK
        text type
        text priority
        text status
        jsonb tasks
        jsonb photos
    }
    MOBILE_NOTIFICATIONS {
        text id PK
        text staff_id FK
        text related_report_id
        text title
        text message
        boolean is_read
        timestamptz created_at
    }
    CLOUD_TELEMETRY["TELEMETRY - SUPABASE"] {
        text id PK
        text node_id
        text aircon_id
        double rotation_rpm
        text rotation_quality
        timestamptz observed_at
        numeric interval_seconds
        jsonb control_snapshot
    }
    LOCAL_TELEMETRY["TELEMETRY - SQLITE"] {
        TEXT id PK
        TEXT node_id
        TEXT aircon_id
        REAL rotation_rpm
        TEXT observed_at
        INTEGER interval_seconds
        TEXT control_snapshot
    }

    %% Dashed relationships are non-identifying. Labels ending REF are application associations, not database FKs.
    %% The child aircon_id in maintenance_reports actually references nodes.id.
    %% The rule_nodes (rule_id,node_id) pair is unique as a tuple.
    %% monitor_aircon_id has partial uniqueness for monitoring/both nodes, not a universal UK.

    AUTH_USERS |o..o| ADMINISTRATORS : authenticates
    AUTH_USERS |o..o| STAFF : authenticates
    ADMINISTRATORS |o..o{ BUILDINGS : manages
    BUILDINGS |o..o{ FLOORS : contains
    FLOORS |o..o{ ROOMS : contains
    ADMINISTRATORS |o..o{ ROOMS : owns
    ROOMS |o..o{ NODES : contains
    ROOMS |o..o{ AIRCONS : houses
    ROOMS |o..o{ STAFF : assigns_REF
    STAFF |o..o{ NODES : maintains
    NODES |o..o{ AIRCONS : controls
    AIRCONS |o..o{ NODES : monitors
    ADMINISTRATORS |o..o{ RULES : creates
    RULES ||..o{ RULE_NODES : applies
    NODES ||..o{ RULE_NODES : receives
    RULES |o..o{ NOTIFICATIONS : triggers
    ADMINISTRATORS |o..o{ NOTIFICATIONS : receives
    STAFF |o..o{ MAINTENANCE_REPORTS : handles
    ADMINISTRATORS |o..o{ MAINTENANCE_REPORTS : reviews
    NODES |o..o{ MAINTENANCE_REPORTS : services
    STAFF |o..o{ MOBILE_NOTIFICATIONS : receives
    MAINTENANCE_REPORTS |o..o{ MOBILE_NOTIFICATIONS : alerts_REF
    NODES |o..o{ CLOUD_TELEMETRY : records_REF
    AIRCONS |o..o{ CLOUD_TELEMETRY : tags_REF
    CLOUD_TELEMETRY |o..o| LOCAL_TELEMETRY : archives_REF

    classDef auth fill:#fce7f3,stroke:#ec4899,color:#111827
    classDef location fill:#ccfbf1,stroke:#14b8a6,color:#111827
    classDef device fill:#dcfce7,stroke:#22c55e,color:#111827
    classDef rule fill:#ffedd5,stroke:#f97316,color:#111827
    classDef junction fill:#fef9c3,stroke:#eab308,color:#111827
    classDef alert fill:#e0f2fe,stroke:#0ea5e9,color:#111827
    classDef readings fill:#fee2e2,stroke:#ef4444,color:#111827
    classDef maintenance fill:#ede9fe,stroke:#8b5cf6,color:#111827
    class AUTH_USERS,ADMINISTRATORS,STAFF auth
    class BUILDINGS,FLOORS,ROOMS location
    class NODES,AIRCONS device
    class RULES rule
    class RULE_NODES junction
    class NOTIFICATIONS,MOBILE_NOTIFICATIONS alert
    class CLOUD_TELEMETRY,LOCAL_TELEMETRY readings
    class MAINTENANCE_REPORTS maintenance
